digest.component_or_area: model fallback routing and capability resolution
propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard model classes are approved but not yet configured in rebar.toml, leaving the feature unreachable.

Configuring a model chain currently triggers whole-chain capability intersection that silently downgrades the primary model's native structured output capability to match a fallback's lower capability, even before fallback is invoked.

Live testing proves direct Anthropic Sonnet supports native structured output and thinking without requiring a fallback redesign, but the measured capability row has not been recorded in configuration.

The chain mechanism's conservative up-front intersection is an intentional design decision from prior tickets, not a bug, but it makes the fallback feature unusable for standard-class without accepting a capability regression.
Enabling the Anthropic fallback before fixing credential shadowing in non-interactive contexts (separate issue on ticket 2876) would exercise an invalid credential and fail with HTTP 401.
